title: teos very tuff texture pack
description: Its a very tuff texture pack!!! With a bunch of cool pvp stuff and my face on stuff :) It has a base of PVP UTILS so go credit them. It lowers shield, fire, adds custom totems, gapples, and golden carrots. It also has everything PVP utils has.
body: This is a PVP texture pack based off of the popular pvp pack "PvP Utils". Most textures are from them, i only updated the golden carrots, gapples, and totems. Go credit them and follow them. This is my first texture pack so PLEASEEEEEEE download.
